notes: We provide the raw fitting files as used by H.M. Pickett's spcat and spfit programs. This includes .cat, .int, .lin, .par, .var, .fit and formatted fit files. Conformers are named according to the main text with p referring to '. The 35Cl and 37Cl isotopologues are provided. For the global minimum gG'tG' (gGptGp), fit files for the 20Ne and 22Ne, as well as a combined fit are provided. Additionally, the xyz-files computed at the DCSD-F12b/VDZ-F12 and CCSD(T)-F12c/VDZ-F12 are provided.
